mapper.sql: (cpu_per)::numeric AS "cpuUsage", (mem_server_per)::numeric AS "serverMemUsage", (mem_us)::numeric AS "redisMemUsed", (ops)::numeric AS "qps", (latency)::numeric AS "avgLatency", (io_iik)::numeric AS "netInputBandwidth", (io_iok)::numeric AS "netOutputBandwidth"
mapper.select: SELECT instance_id AS "instanceId", AS "bucket", AVG((cpu_per)::numeric) AS "cpuUsage", AVG((mem_server_per)::numeric) AS "serverMemUsage", AVG((mem_us)::numeric) AS "redisMemUsed", AVG((ops)::numeric) AS "qps", AVG((latency)::numeric) AS "avgLatency", AVG((io_iik)::numeric) AS "netInputBandwidth", AVG((io_iok)::numeric) AS "netOutputBandwidth" FROM rms_metric_log WHERE instance_id IN #{id} AND tm >= #{startTime}::timestamp AND tm < #{endTime}::timestamp GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2

SELECT AVG(cpu_per::numeric) AS "cpuAvg", MAX(cpu_per::numeric) AS "cpuMax", (array_agg(tm ORDER BY cpu_per::numeric DESC NULLS LAST) FILTER (WHERE cpu_per IS NOT NULL))[1] AS "cpuMaxTim",
AVG(mem_us::numeric) AS "redisMemAvg", MAX(mem_us::numeric) AS "redisMemMax", (array_agg(tm ORDER BY mem_us::numeric DESC NULLS LAST) FILTER (WHERE mem_us IS NOT NULL))[1] AS "redisMemMaxTim",
AVG(ops::numeric) AS "qpsAvg", MAX(ops::numeric) AS "qpsMax", (array_agg(tm ORDER BY ops::numeric DESC NULLS LAST) FILTER (WHERE ops IS NOT NULL))[1] AS "qpsMaxTim",
AVG(latency::numeric) AS "latencyAvg", MAX(latency::numeric) AS "latencyMax", (array_agg(tm ORDER BY latency::numeric DESC NULLS LAST) FILTER (WHERE latency IS NOT NULL))[1] AS "latencyMaxTim",
COUNT(*) AS "collectCount", COUNT(cpu_per) AS "cpuCollectCount", COUNT(mem_us) AS "memCollectCount", COUNT(ops) AS "qpsCollectCount", COUNT(latency) AS "latencyCollectCount" FROM rms_metric_log WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND tm BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}

SELECT date_trunc('day', tm)
AS "bucket", AVG((cpu_per)::numeric) AS "cpuUsage", AVG((mem_us)::numeric) AS "redisMemUsed", AVG((ops)::numeric) AS "qps", AVG((latency)::numeric) AS "avgLatency" FROM rms_metric_log WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND tm BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
